Permissions required by samples/azure-pim-access.entra.json (mode: delegated, 4 resource(s))

Microsoft Graph delegated permissions
  Group.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/platform-contributors
      (provider)

Entra roles (the signed-in user needs at least one role of each group)
  Groups Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/platform-contributors
      (provider)

Azure (signed-in identity)
  Azure role assignment write ('Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write', and '.../delete' for deployment delete: Owner, User Access Administrator or Role Based Access Control Administrator) at scope '/subscriptions/6e1f4c2a-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/azureRoleAssignments/18086dde-401b-5705-9ec0-1c66c780bbe0
      (provider: PUT {scope}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/{guid} (deployment delete: DELETE; whatif reads roleAssignments: '.../read', for example Reader))
  Azure role eligibility request ('Microsoft.Authorization/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/write': Owner or User Access Administrator) at scope '/subscriptions/6e1f4c2a-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/azureRoleEligibilityScheduleRequests/2434bbf8-4563-59e7-9c0d-ede58d5a7de0
      (provider: PUT {scope}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/{guid} (AdminAssign; deployment delete AdminRemove; whatif reads roleEligibilitySchedules: '.../read', for example Reader))
  Azure role management policy write ('Microsoft.Authorization/roleManagementPolicies/write': Owner, User Access Administrator or Role Based Access Control Administrator) at scope '/subscriptions/6e1f4c2a-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/azureRoleManagementPolicies/6ccca77f-b266-5774-a04a-e20ad81a949a
      (provider: PATCH {scope}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleManagementPolicies/{policy} (whatif reads it: '.../read', for example Reader))

note: Delegated scopes must be present on the token that earm auth login obtains (the app registration of --client-id needs them as delegated permissions); the signed-in user must additionally hold at least one role of every 'Entra roles' group (the roles are alternatives).
note: Optional, not listed above: User.ReadBasic.All (or a broader user or directory read such as User.Read.All or Directory.Read.All) lets every online run read the tenant size right after the preflight (GET /users/$count) and pace Graph requests with the tenant's directory budget. A run does not request it: the size is read only when the token already carries such a scope; otherwise the run goes on with the smallest tenant's budget (3,500 resource units per 10 s), which only makes a large deployment slower.
note: Azure role management policies (Microsoft.Entra/azureRoleManagementPolicies) are read and written through Azure Resource Manager with its own token: the signed-in identity needs the Azure RBAC grant listed at each policy's scope (no Graph permission), and a delegated sign-in the one-time Resource Manager consent (earm auth login -f <template>).
note: Azure role grants (Microsoft.Entra/azureRoleAssignments, Microsoft.Entra/azureRoleEligibilityScheduleRequests) are read and written through Azure Resource Manager with its own token: the signed-in identity needs the Azure RBAC grant listed at each declared scope (no Graph permission), and a delegated sign-in the one-time Resource Manager consent (earm auth login -f <template>).
note: Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
